description: Dear Casper,I am writing to you today in support of libraries. Specifically, I am writing in support of public libraries. As a bibliophile it is easy to look at a library and only see the books. The library is a portal into multiple worlds, perspectives, and vast vocabularies and languages.When a person enters the Natrona County Public Library they are greeted with books, sure, but there is so much more.In the library there are computers with free internet. That’s right, really truly free intern

title: Letter to the Editor 7/13/25: More than books: Public library plays vital role in community life
